categories.main_business_segments: Wens Foodstuff Group Co., Ltd. primarily engages in large-scale breeding and sales of broiler chickens and pigs, with additional operations in duck, layer hens, and pigeon breeding. The company also operates in related sectors including slaughtering, food processing, modern agricultural equipment manufacturing, veterinary drug production, and financial investment. Its business model integrates upstream breeding and feed production with downstream processing and sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced breeding technologies including genomic selection, gene editing, and intelligent measurement for poultry and pig breeding. It has a comprehensive R&D system focusing on breeding, nutrition, disease prevention, and environmental control. The production method is a tightly integrated 'company + farmer' model, where the company provides breeding stock, feed, veterinary drugs, and technical support, while farmers handle the fattening stage under strict supervision and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include wholesalers and meat processing plants for live broilers and pigs, with products distributed nationwide. The company also serves large food processing enterprises, catering groups, and retail consumers through fresh and processed meat products. Its markets cover various regions in China, with products suitable for households, restaurants, and institutional dining.
categories.geographic_coverage: Wens operates extensively across China with regional divisions in South China, Northeast, East China, Southwest, Central China, North China, and Northwest. It has subsidiaries and operations in multiple provinces and cities, including Guangdong, Guangxi, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Sichuan, Hubei, Henan, and others, reflecting a broad national footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the entire supply chain from upstream breeding and feed production to midstream farming and downstream slaughtering, processing, and sales. It controls core upstream breeding technologies and feed formulation, manages midstream farming via contracted farmers, and is expanding downstream processing and marketing capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening breeding technology innovation, disease prevention, nutrition optimization, and environmental sustainability. The company invests heavily in R&D, focusing on genomic breeding, biosecurity, waste resource utilization, and digital transformation including AI and big data applications. It aims to enhance production efficiency, product quality, and industry leadership through continuous innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through sales of live broilers, pigs, fresh meat products, and processed foods. The company also earns income from feed and veterinary drug sales, equipment manufacturing, and financial investments. Sales are mostly on a wholesale basis with direct distribution to customers, and the company is transitioning towards integrated slaughtering, branded products, and cold chain logistics.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Wens is a leading modern agricultural enterprise in China, ranking among the top in broiler and pig production volumes nationally. It holds a dominant market share in the listed companies segment and is recognized as a national key leading enterprise in agricultural industrialization. Competitors include other large-scale integrated livestock companies and regional players, but Wens maintains competitive advantages through its integrated model and technological capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Wens reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 104.86 billion, a 16.64% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 9.23 billion, reversing previous losses. The company’s total assets reached RMB 93.86 billion, with equity attributable to shareholders increasing by 23.87%. The company shows a strong growth trajectory supported by scale expansion and improved profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Wens emphasizes its tightly integrated 'company + farmer' model, advanced breeding technologies, and comprehensive quality control to ensure product safety and consistency. Its unique value lies in combining modern scientific breeding with traditional Chinese poultry genetics, extensive R&D, and digital management systems. The company also focuses on sustainable and eco-friendly farming practices, aiming to provide high-quality, safe, and traceable meat products to the market.
